summary: Equinox Gold and Orla Mining entered a definitive arrangement agreement for an at-market combination, with Equinox acquiring all Orla shares via a court-approved plan of arrangement. Terms: Orla shareholders receive 1.00 Equinox share plus $0.0001 cash per Orla share (exchange ratio). Post-close, Equinox holders own ~67% and Orla holders ~33% of the combined firm. The board (no advisor named) recommends the deal, which creates a North American senior gold producer. Completion is subject to regulatory and court approvals. Watch for shareholder votes and close timing; risk-arb focuses on exchange ratio stability and regulatory clearance.
